messages:
maria: FYI: Scheduled routing-eviction simulation + controlled failover this Saturday (2026-04-04). Target: test graceful fallback to model-compat pool and assess SLO impact. Details below. :rotating_light:

sre-oncall-bot: Calendar event created: "routed-eviction-sim" Sat 04 Apr 2026 04:00-05:00 UTC — see link: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/abcd1234

maria: Window: 04:00-05:00 UTC. Canary at 04:10 UTC (region-west), full ramp at 04:25 UTC. Expected: short p99 spikes (~200-400ms) and occasional 502s during endpoint handoff. We'll run two 10-minute eviction passes. No customer-facing config changes required.

james: Re: alerts — can we mute the SLO alert for the window? I'll mute ops alerts for region-west for 45m.

ops: I'll run the mute 10m before canary. Command: `./ops mute-alert --scope=region-west --duration=45m --alert=endpoint-latency-p99`

alice: Tagged the runbook and added a checklist. Runbook: /runbooks/sre/routed-eviction-sim.md

maria: TL;DR action items:
- Oncall: watch canary (04:10)
- Eng-runtime: have fallback variant ready and heat caches prewarm
- Observability: disable paging for non-critical SLOs, keep metrics and traces
- Support: standby for potential customer escalations

tanya: Prewarm commands for model pool:
```
redwoodctl pool prewarm --pool model-compat --targets 80%
redwoodctl cache warm --keys recent-prefixes --timeout 5m
```

james: Noted. I'll also set a temporary routing policy to favor warm pool: `routing:set --pool=model-compat --weight=80` during the sim.

maria: If we see lasting degradation > 15m after rollbacks, escalate to incident channel. Otherwise, we treat this as planned maintenance and post a summary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for routed-eviction-sim at 04:10:03 UTC (region-west)

sre-oncall-bot: Reminder (4m): Canary pass 1 running. Check p99, error-rate, and fallback success metric `fallback_success_rate`.

alice: Canary pass 1 complete. p99 spike 320ms, fallback_success_rate 98%, 3x 502s during handoff, all routed to fallback automatically. 

maria: Nice. Proceeding to pass 2 (start 04:25). Ops keep mute in place.

alice: Pass 2 complete. p99 returned to baseline after 1m. No manual intervention required.

james: Unmuting non-critical alerts now.

maria: Summary: Simulation met objectives. Minor transient errors observed; fallback worked as expected. We'll publish a short postmortem with action items (cache prewarm automation, add metric for connection-drain-duration). Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

support: Noted. I'll prepare a one-paragraph customer-safe summary for support docs.
